AasgConfig.schema: Configuration schema version. AASG currently requires 9; see the migration guide for older configurations.
AasgConfig.project: Artifact locations and default capture timeout, relative to this configuration file.
AasgConfig.android: Gradle, instrumentation, device and AndroidX Test Storage configuration.
AasgConfig.variants: Available locales, themes and named capture groups.
AasgConfig.captures: Named instrumentation capture journeys; each entry declares its test and produced artifacts.
AasgConfig.pipelines: Named sequences of typed image or video rendering operations.
AasgConfig.frame_sources: Declared device frame providers with license provenance.

ProjectConfig.artifact_root: Root for stable capture artifacts, relative to this configuration file. Defaults to artifacts.
ProjectConfig.run_log_root: Root for run manifests and redacted logs. Defaults to artifacts/aasg/runs.
ProjectConfig.default_timeout_seconds: Positive timeout in seconds used when a capture has no override. Defaults to 90.

AndroidConfig.min_api: Minimum supported Android API level. Defaults to 33.
AndroidConfig.adb: ADB executable name or path. Defaults to adb.
AndroidConfig.gradle_wrapper: Project Gradle wrapper path, relative to this configuration file.
AndroidConfig.prepare_tasks: Gradle tasks to prepare or install the app and tests before capture.
AndroidConfig.test_task: Gradle task that executes the app's instrumentation capture tests.
AndroidConfig.additional_output_dir: Host directory containing collected AndroidX Test Storage output.
AndroidConfig.locale_argument: Instrumentation argument name used to pass the selected locale.
AndroidConfig.theme_argument: Instrumentation argument name used to pass the selected theme.

DirectInstrumentationConfig.application_id: Android application ID of the app under test.
DirectInstrumentationConfig.test_application_id: Android application ID of the instrumentation test APK.
DirectInstrumentationConfig.runner: Fully qualified instrumentation runner class. Cmd/Ctrl-click navigates to its declaration.
DirectInstrumentationConfig.app_apk: App APK path relative to this configuration file.
DirectInstrumentationConfig.test_apk: Instrumentation APK path relative to this configuration file.
DirectInstrumentationConfig.device_output_dir: Safe absolute device directory holding test output.

VariantsConfig.locales: Nonempty mapping of locale IDs to instrumentation argument values.
VariantsConfig.themes: Nonempty mapping of theme IDs to instrumentation argument values.
VariantsConfig.groups: Named lists of capture IDs for selecting several journeys together.

CaptureConfig.label: Human-readable capture label shown by the CLI.
CaptureConfig.description: Optional explanatory text shown below the capture label.
CaptureConfig.test: Fully qualified instrumentation class or Class#method selector; multiple selectors may be comma-separated. Cmd/Ctrl-click navigates to the declaration.
CaptureConfig.arguments: Additional string-to-string instrumentation arguments for this capture.
CaptureConfig.timeout_seconds: Positive timeout override in seconds; otherwise uses the project default.
CaptureConfig.locales: Optional subset of locale IDs declared in variants.locales.
CaptureConfig.themes: Optional subset of theme IDs declared in variants.themes.
CaptureConfig.navigation: Capture navigation policy: ignore (default), gestural, three-button, or all.
CaptureConfig.defaults: Typed permission, role and setting defaults, applied before capture and restored afterwards.
CaptureConfig.show_taps: Show Android's tap indicator while capturing. Defaults to true.
CaptureConfig.artifacts: Files produced by this journey; source paths are inferred from capture and artifact IDs.

ArtifactConfig.id: Path-safe artifact ID, unique within this capture.
ArtifactConfig.type: Produced media type: image, video or json.
ArtifactConfig.metadata: Whether the image or video has an AASG semantic metadata sidecar. Defaults to false.
ArtifactConfig.renditions: Additional rendered publications using named pipelines.

RenditionConfig.pipeline: ID of a rendering pipeline declared in pipelines.
RenditionConfig.extension: Optional output extension override, such as .png or .mp4.

PermissionDefault.type: Permission default discriminator; must be permission.
PermissionDefault.package: Android package whose runtime permission is changed.
PermissionDefault.state: Desired permission state: granted or revoked.

RoleDefault.type: Role default discriminator; must be role.
RoleDefault.holders: Unique Android package names that should hold the role.

ResizeStep.type: Resize operation discriminator; must be resize.
ResizeStep.fit: Resize fit: contain, cover or stretch. Defaults to contain.

CropStep.type: Crop operation discriminator; must be crop.
CropStep.x: Left coordinate of a literal crop rectangle.
CropStep.y: Top coordinate of a literal crop rectangle.
CropStep.width: Positive width of a literal crop rectangle.
CropStep.height: Positive height of a literal crop rectangle.
CropStep.region: Semantic metadata region ID, used instead of a literal crop rectangle.
CropStep.padding: Nonnegative padding around the crop region in pixels.

PadStep.type: Padding operation discriminator; must be pad.

BackgroundStep.type: Background operation discriminator; must be background.
BackgroundStep.color: Background color, or mapping of theme IDs to colors.

BlurStep.type: Blur operation discriminator; must be blur.

RedactStep.type: Redaction operation discriminator; must be redact.
RedactStep.regions: Nonempty list of semantic region IDs to redact.
RedactStep.color: Solid redaction color. Defaults to black.

DeviceFrameStep.type: Device frame operation discriminator; must be device_frame.
DeviceFrameStep.source: Frame provider ID declared in frame_sources.
DeviceFrameStep.frame: Contained frame ID within the declared provider.
DeviceFrameStep.fit: Screen fit: contain, cover (default) or stretch.
DeviceFrameStep.background: Optional background color, or mapping of theme IDs to colors.
DeviceFrameStep.crop_to_frame: Crop the output canvas to the device frame. Defaults to false.

EdgeFadeStep.type: Edge fade operation discriminator; must be edge_fade.
EdgeFadeStep.edges: Nonempty selection of top, right, bottom or left edges.

FeatherStep.type: Feather operation discriminator; must be feather.
FeatherStep.pixels: Positive alpha feather distance in pixels.

TrimStep.type: Video trim operation discriminator; must be trim.
TrimStep.start_seconds: Nonnegative trim start time in seconds. Defaults to zero.
TrimStep.duration_seconds: Positive retained video duration in seconds.

TemporalFadeStep.type: Video fade operation discriminator; must be temporal_fade.
TemporalFadeStep.in_seconds: Nonnegative fade-in duration in seconds. Defaults to zero.
TemporalFadeStep.out_seconds: Nonnegative fade-out duration in seconds. Defaults to zero.

GestureOverlayStep.type: Gesture overlay discriminator; must be gesture_overlay. Must be the first pipeline step.
GestureOverlayStep.color: Gesture color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA format. Defaults to #FFFFFF.
GestureOverlayStep.halo_color: Gesture halo color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA format. Defaults to #000000A0.
GestureOverlayStep.radius_px: Positive gesture marker radius in pixels. Defaults to 44.
GestureOverlayStep.trail: Draw gesture motion trails. Defaults to true.
GestureOverlayStep.timing_offset_ms: Gesture timing offset in milliseconds, from -10000 to 10000.

PipelineConfig.steps: Ordered list of typed FFmpeg rendering operations.
PipelineConfig.frame_rate: Positive output video frame rate. Defaults to 30.
PipelineConfig.crf: Video encoder constant rate factor, from 0 to 51. Defaults to 18.

RemoteFrameSource.kind: Remote frame provider discriminator; must be device-frames-media.
RemoteFrameSource.index_url: Remote provider index URL. Assets retain their own licenses and provenance.
RemoteFrameSource.allow_unlicensed_downloads: Explicitly permit downloading assets without declared licenses. Defaults to false.

LocalFrameSource.kind: Local frame provider discriminator; must be local.
LocalFrameSource.root: Declared frame directory, relative to this configuration file.
LocalFrameSource.license: License provenance for the local device frame assets.

SettingDefault.type: Setting default discriminator; must be setting.
SettingDefault.namespace: Android settings namespace: system, secure or global.
SettingDefault.key: Setting key. system.show_touches is reserved for show_taps.
SettingDefault.value: String setting value, or null to remove the setting.
